form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. table-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Query
form:FormGroup.helpText: Query component that supplies the results for this table.

form:FormGroup.label: Extraction Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to extract field values when Extract Values is ticked and Use Default Extraction Pipeline is not. You need Use permission on the pipeline.

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum Results
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of results to keep at each grouping level, as a comma-separated list, e.g. 1000000,100,10 (the last value applies to any deeper levels). Leave blank to use the system default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Comma-separated, one per group level, e.g. 1000000,100,10. Blank uses default.

form:FormGroup.label: Table Page Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of rows shown on each page of the table, from 1 to 10,000. Default is 100.
